items.title: Why Is Bank Of America (BAC) Committing $250 Billion And Investing $1.9 Billion Abroad?
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) agreed to acquire up to a 49.9% stake in Jio Credit Limited for about US$1.9b, expanding into India’s consumer finance market. The bank also introduced a Critical Infrastructure Finance Initiative that commits US$250b to U.S. infrastructure projects over the next 18 months. items.title: Why AI is unlikely to be an apocalypse for jobs
items.summary: Investing.com -- Artificial intelligence is more likely to replace individual tasks than entire occupations, limiting the risk of widespread job destruction, BofA Global Research said in a report examining employment across 206 US industries.
